notes: Live Nuxt/Storyblok storefront, no ClaudeBot restriction in robots.txt (only SEO-crawler disallows). No precedent in this project; independently extracted via UAE locale path (/ae/c/...). Site is technically operated on shared 'Leem Global' infrastructure (Cloudinary asset host res.cloudinary.com/leem-global/, Storyblok content path published/en/aura/ae/, robots.txt Sitemap points to leem.com) -- Aura Living appears to be a sister brand under the same Gulf retail group as Leem, but serves its own distinct product catalogue at auraliving.com; not a duplicate-company case (no prior Leem or Aura extraction exists in this project). Each category's qty verified by extracting the site's embedded Nuxt SSR payload (window.__NUXT__) and reading the ProductQueryAura component's pagination.total for the Storyblok category API (category path /category-1/<Cat>/category-2/<Sub>, region=ae), then exhaustion-checked by fetching page=2/3 and confirming the cumulative unique product slug count equals the reported total (confirmed exact on all 9 categories fetched: 26, 29, 10, 5, 60, 36, 36, 37, 26). Mixed-roll-up categories were filtered by inspecting every product title (and product-detail meta description for ambiguous ones): Decorative Accessories (26 total) drops 1 Ramadan/holiday door-decor item, 1 steel BBQ firepit, 1 fragrance diffuser, and 4 Silsal 'Mabkhara' bukhoor/incense burners -> 19 in scope. Flowers and Vases (29 total) drops 10 faux/artificial plants and florals (title says 'Faux' or product description confirms 'faux botanicals') -> 19 vases/planters in scope. Candles and Candle Holders (60 total) drops 26 items: explicitly scented candles (Jana line, Scented Ceramic Candle, Sophia Ombre Glass Candle whose description advertises 'sophisticated aroma'), scented gift-box sets, the entire Silsal Fares Oud Wood Candle line and Silsal 'The ___'/Naseem candle lines (all confirmed hand-poured SCENTED via product description), and one non-candle Silsal Candle Care Kit (wick trimmer/snuffer/dipper tool set) -> 34 unscented candles + candle holders in scope. Bathroom Accessories (26 total) keeps only decorative trays/leather catchall trays (7) and drops 19 tissue boxes/soap dispensers/waste bins as storage/fixture items per Rule 0.4. Tableware sub-categories filed under 'Kitchen & Dining' per brief: Dinnerware (36, all plates/bowls/chargers in scope), Serveware (36, all trays/cake-stands/platters/dellahs in scope -- verified Saturn Water Dispenser and Nour Najdi Food Warmer are manual metal/glass decor pieces, not electric kitchen appliances), Drinkware (37, all cups/mugs/tumblers/glassware in scope). Cutlery (10) and Table Linen (7) categories exist but are fully out of scope (utensils/textiles) and were not extracted per NEVER-PAD rule. No Clocks category found (site search for 'clock' returns 0 genuine matches). Lighting (all-lighting, flat 5-item category, no room sub-nesting in nav or API) and Mirrors and Wall Decor (10 items, includes both mirrors and decorative wall art/paintings, all in scope per Rule 0.3 and the wall-art include rule) required no filtering. 'All Decor' and 'Collections' (Dahlia/Kiera/Rania/Summer Edits) roll-up/marketing pages were not extracted per NEVER EXTRACT rule; Cushions and Throws and Rugs (textiles) and Made To Order (furniture) were out of scope entirely.
